scope: Proposal and feasibility review only. No gap repair, new study, new literature acquisition, manuscript rebuild, independent review or deployment was performed.

decision_basis.G1: Known reproduced consumer-field repair; statistical calibration requires separate work.
decision_basis.G2: Known conditional projection validity route; empirical informativeness and numerical practicality are unresolved. Exact singular mean equations require more identifying information for the focal contrast.
decision_basis.G3: Concrete bounded nonlinear law and audited identification route; general nonlinear identification, optimization and calibrated policy inference are not established.
decision_basis.G4: Known observed-law-region projection route for a bounded structural class; general useful large-PAG confidence is unresolved.
decision_basis.G5: Concrete fixed-map/independent-pair sampling and audit design; unknown semantic truth and unidentified audit bias require additional evidence or sensitivity.
decision_basis.G6: Known selected learning and execution mechanisms; validity under changed models and actual platform/user gains require validation.

review_anchors.anchors: Mean-model rank failure, projection inclusion, ellipsoidal/residual-test alternatives and information requirements.
Small Gaussian covariance-region construction and temporal-class limitations.
Private logger, validation-based identification and two-sample uncertainty.
Exact Gaussian benchmark and nonlinear likelihood/score/value obligations.
Temporal gap, nuisance-rate and HAC replacement conditions.
Global centering, chronological halos and full workload measurement boundary.
Matched expert/product studies and unmeasured analyst/decision value.

note: The new plan and review are separate from the frozen V6.1 manifest; that manifest continues to describe the previously delivered edition.
